journey.name: primary offline receive
journey.description: Proves a receive that needs the primary tells the user when the primary is unreachable, instead of a spinner. Precondition: see README.md; stop the primary node before the quote step and start it again for the retry.

actions.action: Open Receive, switch to the Spending tab, enter an amount above the channel's inbound capacity and continue
Verify "PrimaryReceiveError" says the primary node is offline or unreachable and "PrimaryReceiveRetry" is shown
Start the primary node, wait for the wallet to reconnect, and tap "PrimaryReceiveRetry"
Verify "PrimaryReceiveFee" is shown and "PrimaryReceiveApprove" is enabled
